cards.title: Anchor Tawheed
cards.description: Revisit the testimony of faith and map how it touches your decisions today.
cards.action: Note one area where sincerity must replace habit.

cards.title: Circle with Reminders
cards.description: Schedule a Shahada reminder and a short dua that mentions Allah's oneness.
cards.action: Set a gentle alarm or card to repeat the phrase during the day.

cards.title: Share the Foundation
cards.description: Tell someone a short insight from the chapter and listen to their take.
cards.action: Record one takeaway to revisit before bed.

cards.title: Map the Articles
cards.description: Write down the six beliefs and share how each influences your trust in Allah.
cards.action: Tag one article as the focus for tomorrow's dua.

cards.title: Practice the Unseen
cards.description: Speak aloud about how angels or decree helped you this week.
cards.action: Share the reflection with someone who can keep you accountable.

cards.title: Teach the Pillar
cards.description: Explain the beliefs to a friend or family member and field questions.
cards.action: Jot your notes and keep them handy for future doubts.

cards.title: Live the Pillars
cards.description: Pick one pillar (prayer, zakat, fasting) to honor and monitor it daily.
cards.action: Check your compliance and ask Allah for consistency.

cards.title: Document the Rhythm
cards.description: Track each pillar in a simple habit log for three days.
cards.action: Share the log with a mentor for encouragement.

cards.title: Renew Intention
cards.description: Refresh your niyyah before each act of worship and charity.
cards.action: Repeat a short dua that acknowledges Allah's help.

cards.title: Slow the Recitation
cards.description: Read an ayah with translation and write a one-sentence reflection.
cards.action: Circulate the reflection to someone via voice note or message.

cards.title: Explore the Tafsir
cards.description: Watch or read commentary on the chapter's verses.
cards.action: Note one new lesson and plan to act on it.

cards.title: Apply the Message
cards.description: Perform an action inspired by the Quran verse you studied.
cards.action: Journal how you felt and what you learned.

cards.title: Study His Story
cards.description: Focus on one Prophet event and extract its moral.
cards.action: Record your takeaway and imagine living it this week.

cards.title: Send Blessings
cards.description: Recite salawat while picturing the Prophet's mercy.
cards.action: Share why he inspires you with a friend.

cards.title: Mirror the Manners
cards.description: Respond to a tense moment with gentleness and humility.
cards.action: Reflect on the outcome and thank Allah.

cards.title: Structure Salah
cards.description: Prepare each prayer with intention and awareness.
cards.action: Describe one distracting thought and replace it with a purpose.

cards.title: Slow the Quran in Prayer
cards.description: Understand a verse you recite and speak it softly.
cards.action: Write a summary to use again tomorrow.

cards.title: Link Sunnah
cards.description: Add a Sunnah prayer or dua to your routine.
cards.action: Share the change with a partner and support one another.

cards.title: Practice Adab
cards.description: Deliver kind words to someone you usually rush past.
cards.action: Note how it felt.

cards.title: Guard the Tongue
cards.description: Avoid gossip for a day and fill the space with praise.
cards.action: Pray for patience and dignity.

cards.title: Model Mercy
cards.description: Actively forgive and let go of a minor annoyance.
cards.action: Document how it softened your heart.

cards.title: Design Halal Habits
cards.description: Audit a routine (food, spending, rest) for halal alignment.
cards.action: Replace one element with an intentional choice.

cards.title: Create Calm Time
cards.description: Schedule a reflective pause with dhikr midweek.
cards.action: Share the routine to keep yourself accountable.

cards.title: Give Back
cards.description: Help someone with time or resources aligned with Islamic generosity.
cards.action: Pray for Allah to accept the kindness.

cards.title: Welcome the Ummah
cards.description: Connect with someone new or isolated online/offline.
cards.action: Offer a sincere greeting or helpful link.

cards.title: Support Others
cards.description: Join a study circle or share resources with volunteers.
cards.action: Pray for your brother/sister and note the unity.

cards.title: Resolve Conflict
cards.description: Monitor your speech during a disagreement to stay calm.
cards.action: Seek reconciliation if tension lingers.

cards.title: Sharpen Goals
cards.description: Define a spiritual milestone for the next month.
cards.action: Pair it with a dua and write it down.

cards.title: Review Steps
cards.description: Schedule a weekly reflection on progress and adjustments.
cards.action: Share insight or challenge with an accountability partner.

cards.title: Lift Others
cards.description: Encourage someone pursuing growth and pray together.
cards.action: Record their dua request and commit to revisiting it.

cards.title: Grave Reminder
cards.description: Write a list of priorities shaped by the Hereafter.
cards.action: Attach a dua for mercy in Barzakh.

cards.title: Balance Hope
cards.description: Read a warning from the chapter and reply with hope-filled dua.
cards.action: Share the contrast with a friend to rekindle optimism.

cards.title: Sadaqah That Stays
cards.description: Give charity with a long-term intention.
cards.action: Plan one charity that continues after you pass away.

cards.title: Visualize Paradise
cards.description: Imagine a Quranic description and thank Allah for it.
cards.action: Write how it felt and recite the verse daily.

cards.title: Heed the Warnings
cards.description: Meditate on Hell's cautionary verses and note actions to avoid.
cards.action: Ask someone to remind you when temptation returns.

cards.title: Supplication & Protection
cards.description: Make duas for Paradise and refuge from Hell every night.
cards.action: Share the theme with family to keep hope alive.

cards.title: Speak to Allah
cards.description: Write a dua ranking your needs and praises.
cards.action: Speak it aloud while picturing Allah listening.

cards.title: Embed Dhikr
cards.description: Attach short dhikr phrases to daily movements.
cards.action: Track which phrases calm you most.

cards.title: Lift Others
cards.description: Pray for someone close and mention them by name.
cards.action: Ask them later how they felt.

cards.title: Family Circle
cards.description: Host a mini session with dua, gratitude, and sharing.
cards.action: Document one lesson to keep repeating.

cards.title: Mercy & Justice
cards.description: Acts of kindness and clear boundaries keep harmony.
cards.action: Plan a simple mercy act for a relative.

cards.title: Teach by Example
cards.description: Model manners instead of just instructing.
cards.action: Share a story that inspired your behaviour.

cards.title: Purify the Heart
cards.description: End the day with muhasabah and dua.
cards.action: List a flaw to correct tomorrow.

cards.title: Stay Soft
cards.description: Practice dhikr or charity to soften reactions.
cards.action: Write the emotion you replaced and thank Allah.

cards.title: Focus on Trust
cards.description: Lean on Allah's decree when anxiety arises.
cards.action: Signal a reminder (note or dua) to keep returning to reliance.
